data.one_liner: Draw customizable dotted, dashed, and gradient lines, shapes, and text in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to draw customizable dotted and dashed lines in horizontal or vertical directions. It also supports shadow effects, gradient colors, custom shapes, and dotted text rendering.
use_when: You need to draw custom dotted or dashed lines, boxes, or shapes.
You want to apply gradient colors or shadows to line borders or shapes.
avoid_when: You are looking for heavy-duty charting or plotting tools.
You need complex physics or game engines.
strengths: Supports multiple shapes like stars, cubes, and text rendered in dots.
Includes gradient and shadow support for visual depth.
Customizable dash width, gap, and orientation.
weaknesses: Limited to specific pre-built shapes and dotted components.
data.minimal_example:
DottedLine(
  axis: Axis.horizontal,
  lineThickness: 2,
  dashGap: 4,
  dashWidth: 6,
  colors: [Colors.red, Colors.blue],
)
